text.en: 1. These Regulations may be cited as the Education Endowment and Savings Schemes (Grant to Edusave Pupils Fund) Regulations 2011.

2. For the purposes of section 6(1)(d) of the Act, the income of the Endowment Fund may be paid out and expended for the purpose of providing a top-up grant of $130 to be credited to the Edusave account of every member of the Edusave Pupils Fund who is eligible for the contribution under section 9(1) of the Act for the year 2011.
3. The Education Endowment and Savings Schemes (Grant to Edusave Pupils Fund) Regulations (Rg 5) are revoked.
